breakfast.name: Pastéis de Nata (Custard Tarts)
breakfast.description: Portuguese custard tarts with crispy phyllo pastry and creamy custard filling, dusted with cinnamon
instructions: Make custard: heat milk, whisk yolks with sugar
Add cornstarch mixed with water to milk
Layer phyllo with melted butter in tartlet pans
Bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until golden
breakfast.notes: Custard must be completely cool before filling
breakfast.fun_fact: Pastéis de Nata originated in Belém monastery in Lisbon and are now Portugal's most famous export

lunch.name: Grilled Portuguese Sardines
lunch.description: Simple grilled fresh sardines with lemon and olive oil, Portuguese coastal classic
instructions: Rub with olive oil, garlic, salt, pepper inside and out
Grill over medium-high heat 5 minutes per side
Sardines should be crispy outside, tender inside
lunch.fun_fact: Sardines are central to Portuguese coastal culture and cuisine

dinner.name: Bacalau à Brás (Shredded Cod)
dinner.description: Shredded salted cod mixed with thin-cut fried potatoes and olives
instructions: Soak cod overnight to remove salt
Boil cod until tender, shred finely
Deep fry potatoes until golden and crispy
dinner.fun_fact: Portuguese have a thousand ways to prepare cod (Bacalau à Mil Formas)

snacks.name: Caldo Verde (Green Soup)
snacks.description: Traditional Portuguese green soup with kale and potato
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil
Mash some potatoes to thicken broth
Drizzle with olive oil before serving
snacks.fun_fact: Caldo Verde is eaten across all social classes in Portugal

desserts.name: Arroz Doce (Sweet Rice)
desserts.description: Portuguese sweet rice pudding with cinnamon and lemon
instructions: Cook rice in 2 cups water until tender
Add condensed milk and lemon zest
Remove from heat, stir in butter
Temper egg yolk, add to rice
desserts.fun_fact: Every Portuguese grandmother has their own version of Arroz Doce

nonAlcoholicDrinks.name: Portuguese Lemonade (Limonada)
nonAlcoholicDrinks.description: Refreshing Portuguese lemonade with fresh lemons and water
instructions: Combine juice with water and sugar
nonAlcoholicDrinks.fun_fact: Simple but refreshing summer drink in Portuguese households

alcoholicDrinks.name: Vinho Verde (Green Wine)
alcoholicDrinks.description: Light, slightly fizzy Portuguese white wine from northern Portugal
instructions: Enjoy with food or as aperitif
alcoholicDrinks.fun_fact: Despite the name 'green', Vinho Verde refers to young wine, not the color
